unknown_tokens_policy: Record null; requested caps do not prove actual token ceilings

protocol.ARCHITECT: One common clarification without solving the task, explicitly shared across methods.
protocol.SINGLE: One ChatGPT answer, before sharing GLM opinions.
protocol.REPEATED_SINGLE: Two sequential same-model opinions per round, two subsequent rounds with all prior-round opinions, then ChatGPT synthesis. Statistical independence is not claimed.
protocol.COUNCIL: ChatGPT and GLM first opinions without seeing the other's answer; two subsequent rounds sharing all prior-round opinions, then ChatGPT judgment.

conversation_policy: One conversation per task and model/account from first message through judgment; no switch between methods or rounds.
context_carryover: User-required single conversation causes cross-method carryover. This is an exploratory stateful comparison, not independent randomized treatments. Record exact method execution order and do not infer superiority.
judge_prior_participation: DISCLOSED; CHATGPT IS BOTH PARTICIPANT AND JUDGE
success_criteria: 24 real final outputs and all preceding physical attempts, with exact bytes and hashes.
Immutable plan and account/conversation binding, no premature judge, no blind resend and no secret transfer.
Name-blinded scores against withheld references, declared evaluator origin and independence limitations.
Separate product-flow review, error/fix report, paired descriptive analysis and reestimate; unknown historical hours stay unknown.
Fresh native verification and separate phase acceptance review; original failures remain preserved.
